title: Eclipse
description: A pale plaster wall in the dappled shade of a tree, and a small sun. Slide the moon across it and every soft spot of light on the wall becomes the same crescent at once, because each gap between the leaves was always a pinhole image of the sun. At totality the wall goes blue and the spots become faint rings.
intent: Factory run 2, the only idea of 134 to pass both critics. Reveal that dapples are images of the sun.
